summary.text: Thomas Loecken, an independent candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Kentucky's 2nd Congressional District to Brett Guthrie.
No 2026 campaign website or public statements were found for him.

paragraphs.text: A candidate of the same name ran as an independent for Kentucky's 2nd District in 2018 against Republican Brett Guthrie and Democrat Hank Linderman. In a local newspaper questionnaire that year, he named climate change as the most important issue facing the district.
In the 2026 election, Loecken received 2.1% of the vote to Brett Guthrie's 62.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: Candidate comparison: Guthrie faces two challengers for Kentucky’s 2nd District
